text: In Tokyo, detective Kenichi Takabe investigates killings by ordinary people who confess at once but cannot say why, each victim marked with [a large X carved into the neck or chest|images|wounded and changing bodies]. At home his wife Fumie, who suffers from schizophrenia, keeps getting lost. Every killer had met [Kunihiko Mamiya|trigger|an outsider reaches in], a young man with no memory who once studied mesmerism and seems to [plant homicidal suggestions|rules|it gets inside you] with the flame of a lighter or the motion of water, while [Takabe himself|who_suffers|those who step in] begins to fray.
